nodes.text: fix, feat, or feat! touching a component path

nodes.text: tags X.Y.Z and latest, digest signed keyless

steps.caption: A releasable commit merges to main. The paths it touches decide which component it counts toward.
release-please opens or updates that component's release PR with the version bump and the changelog.
The release-pr-automerge job turns on auto-merge, so the PR lands once its required checks pass.
Merging the release PR creates the component tag and the GitHub Release.
The artifacts job builds every path released in that run, uploads the tarball and checksums, and signs the checksums. A present release also builds and signs its image.
